## PREVIEW | Sassuolo vs AC Milan: team news, lineups, predictions (Serie A 11/10)

Sassuolo and AC Milan face each other this Sunday at the on Match Day six of the Serie A.

Sassuolo have won 7 points to date and are placed in 10th position. In their last encounter, Alberto Aquilani's team were beaten 2-1 by Monza (Serie A 2026/27).

Predicted bench: Bouyer, Torriani, Tomori, Gabbia, Diawara, F. Terracciano, Estupinan, Jashari, Musah, Comotto, Loftus-Cheek, Cisse, Hutchinson, Camarda.

Injuries & suspensions: Terracciano, Saelemaekers.

## The opponents

Aquilani was picked up by Sassuolo in the summer after impressing with Catanzaro in Serie B. He was really unlucky not to get promoted, as Monza only won the play-offs final thanks to their initial league position. It was 2-2 on aggregate, but they prevailed anyway. [...] Predicted bench: Turati, Satalino, Van der Brempt, Odenthal, Obrador, Ghion, Lipani, Bakola, Sulemana, Skjellerup, Dominguez, Pierini, Bowie.

Injuries & suspensions: Ismael Kone.

## Head to head

There have been 26 meetings between Milan and Sassuolo in the past, with the Rossoneri getting the most wins at 13. However, the Neroverdi are not far behind at eight, while five have ended in draws. A pretty even fixture, in other words. [...] In the most recent game, a howler from Muric and a penalty given away allowed Monza to clinch a 2-1 win, even if Sassuolo came close by hitting the post at the end. It was actually Monza’s first win of the season, so unlike Milan, the break perhaps came at a good time for the Aquilani’s side.

Predicted Sassuolo XI (4-3-3): Muric; Cinquegrano, Caleta-Car, Leysen, Doig; Adzic, Matic, Thorstvedt; Berardi, Esposito, Lauriente.
